assertions.assertion: Cornerstone United denied CPT 93271 (Cardiac Event Monitoring)
CO-97 indicates the service is bundled and not separately payable
The appeal is on medical necessity
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The symptoms are consistent with a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Cardiac event monitoring is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances through extended ambulatory assessment
The request is for reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 280.18 for this separately indicated service
